_meta.indication: Indicated in pediatric patients 2 to 12 years of age for the treatment of Chagas disease (American trypanosomiasis) caused by Trypanosoma cruzi

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, parallel-group, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted in Argentina
pivotal_trials.population: Pediatric patients 6 to 12 years of age with chronic indeterminate Chagas disease
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Conversion to negative (seronegative) by nonconventional F29 ELISA anti-T. cruzi IgG serology at end of follow-up
pivotal_trials.n: 106 patients randomized (benznidazole N=55, placebo N=51); efficacy analysis used evaluable subsets (benznidazole N=40, placebo N=37)
pivotal_trials.result: By nonconventional F29 ELISA at end of follow-up (mITT), 24/40 (60.0%) benznidazole vs 5/37 (13.5%) placebo were seronegative; difference 46.5 (95% CI 24.5, 64.4)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled trial conducted in Brazil
pivotal_trials.population: Pediatric patients 7 to 12 years of age with chronic indeterminate Chagas disease
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Conversion to negative (seronegative) by nonconventional AT-chemiluminescence ELISA anti-T. cruzi IgG serology at end of follow-up
pivotal_trials.result: By nonconventional ELISA at end of follow-up (mITT), 35/64 (54.7%) benznidazole vs 3/65 (4.6%) placebo were seronegative; difference 50.1 (95% CI 35.8, 63.4)

key_safety: Most frequent adverse reactions in Trial 1 were abdominal pain (25%), rash (16%), decreased weight (13%), and headache (7%); in Trial 2 skin lesions occurred in 7 of 64 (11%) benznidazole patients. Benznidazole was discontinued for an adverse reaction in 5/55 (9%) patients in Trial 1.
target_moa: Benznidazole is a nitroimidazole antiprotozoal agent (N-benzyl 2-nitroimidazole derivative) with activity against Trypanosoma cruzi trypomastigotes and amastigotes

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee was not convened because there were no issues raised in the course of the NDA review that would benefit from advisory committee discussion

surrogate_endpoint.text: The number of treated patients who became IgG antibody negative against the recombinant antigens of T. cruzi (conversion to negative on nonconventional serologic assays), reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on the number of treated patients who became Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibody negative against the recombinant antigens of *T. cruzi* [see *Clinical Studies* (14)]. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.

summary.text: This 505(b)(2) NDA received December 29, 2016 was granted orphan drug designation (April 14, 2014) and priority review (February 23, 2017), and was approved under Subpart H accelerated approval on August 29, 2017 based on the surrogate endpoint of conversion to IgG antibody negative against T. cruzi recombinant antigens, with a required confirmatory trial. A tropical disease priority review voucher was also granted.

citations.quote: The regulatory action is approval under Subpart H for the treatment of Chagas disease in pediatric patients 2 to 12 years of age.

Date	August 29, 2017
From	Thomas Smith, M.D., Sumathi Nambiar, M.D., M.P.H., and John Farley, M.D., M.P.H.
Subject	Combined Cross-Discipline Team Leader Review, Division Director, and Deputy Office Director Summary Review
NDA #	209570
Applicant	Chemo Research, S.L.
Date of Submission	December 29, 2016
PDUFA Goal Date	August 29, 2017
Non-Proprietary Name	Benznidazole
Dosage form / Strengths	Tablets
Chemo was granted orphan drug designation for benznidazole for the treatment of Chagas disease on April 14, 2014.
Priority review designation was granted February 23, 2017, because Chagas disease is a rare disease, and until now, there are no approved drugs for it in the U.S.
We also inform you that you have been granted a tropical disease priority review voucher, as provided under section 524 of the FDCA.
